The simulation is a 2D transient sloshing case in a rectangular tank using interFoam.
The tank domain spans x from 0 to 1.0 m, y from 0 to 0.6 m, and z from 0 to 0.1 m.
Use blockMesh to create a uniform mesh with 200 cells in x, 120 cells in y, and 1 cell in z.
Set the frontAndBack patches to type empty.
Apply gravity as g = (0 -9.81 0).
Initialize velocity to U = (0 0 0).
Initialize p_rgh to 0.
Initialize the water phase using setFields with 10 boxToCell slices.
For each slice, set alpha.water = 1 inside the box from y = 0 up to the specified height, and set all other cells to alpha.water = 0.
Use the slice heights 0.255 m for x = 0.0 to 0.1 m, 0.265 m for x = 0.1 to 0.2 m, 0.275 m for x = 0.2 to 0.3 m, 0.285 m for x = 0.3 to 0.4 m, 0.295 m for x = 0.4 to 0.5 m, 0.305 m for x = 0.5 to 0.6 m, 0.315 m for x = 0.6 to 0.7 m, 0.325 m for x = 0.7 to 0.8 m, 0.335 m for x = 0.8 to 0.9 m, and 0.345 m for x = 0.9 to 1.0 m.
Apply the noSlip boundary condition for U on the left, right, and bottom walls.
Apply fixedFluxPressure for p_rgh on the left, right, and bottom walls.
Apply zeroGradient for alpha.water on the left, right, and bottom walls.
Apply pressureInletOutletVelocity for U on the top boundary at y = 0.6 m.
Apply totalPressure with p0 = 0 for p_rgh on the top boundary.
Apply inletOutlet with inletValue = 0 for alpha.water on the top boundary.
Set the total simulation time endTime to 10 s.
Set deltaT to 1e-3 s.
Set adjustTimeStep to yes.
Set maxCo to 0.5.
Set writeInterval to 0.05 s.
Run the case with the interFoam solver.
